parameters.content:
## start_seo_article
Queues one grounded SEO article from saved research. No new paid search and no publishing.

parameters.jsCode: const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;const sessionId=String($json.sessionId??'').trim(),requestId=String($json.requestId??'').trim();let domain=String($json.domain??'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').split('/')[0].replace(/^www\./,'').replace(/\.$/,'');const labels=domain.split('.');const primaryKeyword=String($json.primaryKeyword??'').trim().slice(0,200),chooseStrongestKeyword=$json.chooseStrongestKeyword===true;const supportingKeywords=String($json.supportingKeywords??'').split(/[,\n]/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20);const sourceUrls=String($json.sourceUrls??'').split(/[\s,]+/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12);let error=null;if(!uuid.test(sessionId)||!uuid.test(requestId))error={code:'INVALID_REQUEST',message:'The article needs a valid conversation.'};else if(!domain||domain.includes('@')||domain.includes(':')||labels.length<2||labels.some(l=>!/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/.test(l)))error={code:'INVALID_DOMAIN',message:'Use a complete public business domain such as example.com.'};else if(!primaryKeyword&&!chooseStrongestKeyword)error={code:'KEYWORD_REQUIRED',message:'Name the main topic, or ask me to choose the strongest saved keyword.'};else if(sourceUrls.some(v=>!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(?:\/[^\s]*)?$/i.test(v)||v.includes('@')||/:\d+(?:\/|$)/.test(v)))error={code:'INVALID_SOURCE',message:'Article sources must be complete public HTTPS links.'};return{json:{valid:!error,sessionId,requestId,domain,primaryKeyword,chooseStrongestKeyword,supportingKeywords,targetAudience:String($json.targetAudience??'').trim().slice(0,1000),goal:String($json.goal??'').trim().slice(0,1000),sourceUrls,...(error?{response:{ok:false,error}}:{})}};

const input=$('Validate Article Brief').first().json;const paid=$('Read Saved SEO Research').first().json.body??$('Read Saved SEO Research').first().json.data??{};const free=$json.body??$json.data??{};const snapshot=paid.snapshot;const memories=Array.isArray(free.memories)?free.memories:[];const memory=memories[0];if(!snapshot&&!memory)return{json:{...input,ready:false,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'RESEARCH_REQUIRED',message:'I need saved domain research before I can write a grounded article. Research the domain first, then try again.'}}}};const candidates=[...(Array.isArray(snapshot?.selectedKeywords)?snapshot.selectedKeywords:[]),...(Array.isArray(snapshot?.keywordCandidates)?snapshot.keywordCandidates:[]),...(Array.isArray(memory?.keywordCandidates)?memory.keywordCandidates:[])];const word=v=>typeof v==='string'?v.trim():'';const keywordOf=v=>word(v?.keyword)||word(v?.term)||word(v?.name);let primaryKeyword=input.primaryKeyword;if(!primaryKeyword&&input.chooseStrongestKeyword)primaryKeyword=candidates.map(keywordOf).find(v=>v.length>1)||'';if(!primaryKeyword)return{json:{...input,ready:false,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'KEYWORD_REQUIRED',message:'The saved research has no clear keyword to choose. Tell me the article topic.'}}}};const supporting=[...input.supportingKeywords,...candidates.map(keywordOf)].filter(v=>v&&v.toLowerCase()!==primaryKeyword.toLowerCase()).filter((v,i,a)=>a.findIndex(x=>x.toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase())===i).slice(0,12);return{json:{...input,ready:true,primaryKeyword,supportingKeywords:supporting,researchAvailable:{paid:!!snapshot,free:!!memory}}};

const input=$('Resolve Grounded Brief').first().json,body=$json.body??$json.data??{},status=Number($json.statusCode??0),job=body.job;if(status<200||status>=300||!job?.jobId)return{json:{...input,registered:false,response:{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_QUEUE_FAILED',message:'I could not queue the article safely. Nothing was written.'}}}};return{json:{...input,registered:true,created:body.created===true,jobId:job.jobId,job}};

const i=$('Check Job Registration').first().json,status=i.created?'queued':i.job.status;const messages={queued:'I’m preparing the article in the background. Ask me to check it shortly.',running:'That article is already being prepared. Ask me to check it shortly.',completed:'That article is already ready. Ask me to show the download link.',partial:'That article is already ready with warnings. Ask me to show the download link.',failed:'That earlier article attempt failed. Ask me to check it for the reason.',interrupted:'That earlier article attempt was interrupted. Ask me to check it for the reason.'};return{json:{...i,response:{ok:true,status,jobId:i.jobId,domain:i.domain,primaryKeyword:i.primaryKeyword,message:messages[status]??messages.queued}}};

const base=$('Validate Article Brief').first().json,r=$json.response??{ok:false,error:{code:'ARTICLE_QUEUE_FAILED',message:'The article could not be queued.'}};return{json:{occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),sessionId:base.sessionId,requestId:base.requestId,toolName:'start_seo_article',proposedInput:JSON.stringify({domain:base.domain,primaryKeyword:base.primaryKeyword,chooseStrongestKeyword:base.chooseStrongestKeyword}),result:JSON.stringify(r),error:r.ok===false?String(r.error?.message??'Tool failed'):'',response:r}};
const p=$('Prepare Audit').item.json,r={...p.response};if(!Number.isInteger($json.id))r.auditWarning='The start could not be written to the local audit table.';return{json:r};
